title_sq: Tek Rruga "Dritan Hoxha", Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Orientim Jug!
description_sq: Ne zonen e Laprakes, Rruga "Dritan Hoxha", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt Dhe Pamje Te Lire. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 103.16 m2 dhe 89.64 m2 neto. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje godine 13-kateshe me ashensor, ne fazen perfundimtare te ndertimit. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne ambiente, nje dhome matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti, nje dhome per femije, dy tualete dhe ballkoni. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e ventiluar, me termoizolim dhe izolim akustik ; dritare me dopio xham me mbushje me gaz; Pallati eshte i lokalizuar ne rruge kryesore, ka akses ne transport publik dhe afersi me bankat, institucionet.
title_en: At "Dritan Hoxha" Street, 2+1 South Facing Apartment For Sale!
description_en: In the area of ​​Laprak, "Dritan Hoxha" Street, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale with a regular floor plan and a free view. The apartment has a total area of ​​103.16 m2 and 89.64 m2 net. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a 13-story building with an elevator, in the final phase of construction. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a corridor that divides the premises, a matrimonial room with access to the balcony and toilet, a room for children, two toilets and a balcony. The orientation of the apartment is south. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade, with thermal insulation and acoustic insulation; gas-filled double-glazed windows; The building is located on the main road, has access to public transport and is close to banks and institutions.
